expression: ledgr_snapshot_hash_rule_version <- function(con, snapshot_id) {     if (!ledgr_experiment_store_table_exists(con, "snapshots") || !"hash_rule_version" %in% ledgr_experiment_store_columns(con, "snapshots")) {         return(NA_integer_)     }     value <- DBI::dbGetQuery(con, "SELECT hash_rule_version FROM snapshots WHERE snapshot_id = ?", params = list(snapshot_id))$hash_rule_version     if (length(value) == 0L || is.na(value[[1L]]))          return(NA_integer_)     value <- as.integer(value[[1L]])     if (!value %in% c(1L, 2L, 3L)) {         rlang::abort(sprintf("Unsupported snapshot hash rule version: %s.", value), class = c("ledgr_snapshot_hash_rule_unsupported", "ledgr_invalid_state"))     }     value }

ledgr_valuation_policy_record_version <- function(x) {     if (!is.list(x) || !identical(x$type_id, "stale_sessions") || !is.integer(x$max_sessions) || length(x$max_sessions) != 1L || is.na(x$max_sessions) || x$max_sessions < 0L) {         return(NA_integer_)     }     fields <- sort(names(x))     v1_fields <- sort(c("schema_version", "type_id", "max_sessions"))     if (identical(x$schema_version, 1L) && identical(fields, v1_fields)) {         return(1L)     }     if (identical(x$schema_version, 2L) && identical(fields, sort(c(v1_fields, "exhausted"))) && is.character(x$exhausted) && length(x$exhausted) == 1L && !is.na(x$exhausted) && x$exhausted %in% ledgr_valuation_exhausted_choices()) {         return(2L)     }     NA_integer_ }

ledgr_experiment_store_version <- function(con, table_names = NULL) {     has_metadata <- if (is.null(table_names)) {         ledgr_experiment_store_table_exists(con, "ledgr_schema_metadata")     }     else {         "ledgr_schema_metadata" %in% table_names     }     if (!has_metadata) {         return(0L)     }     row <- DBI::dbGetQuery(con, "
    SELECT value
    FROM ledgr_schema_metadata
    WHERE key = 'experiment_store_schema_version'
    ")     if (nrow(row) == 0L) {         return(0L)     }     version <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(row$value[[1]]))     if (length(version) != 1L || is.na(version)) {         rlang::abort("Experiment store schema version is not a valid integer.", class = "ledgr_invalid_schema_version")     }     version }

ledgr_dependency_versions_json <- function() {     packages <- c("ledgr", "collapse", "duckdb", "DBI", "digest", "yyjsonr", "tibble", "TTR")     versions <- list(R = as.character(getRversion()))     for (pkg in packages) {         versions[[pkg]] <- if (requireNamespace(pkg, quietly = TRUE)) {             as.character(utils::packageVersion(pkg))         }         else {             NA_character_         }     }     unname(canonical_json(versions)) }

ledgr_sweep_assert_parent_schema_version <- function(parent) {     version <- as.integer(parent$sweep_schema_version[[1]])     if (is.na(version) || version > ledgr_saved_sweep_schema_version || version < 1L) {         rlang::abort(sprintf("Saved sweep schema version %s is incompatible with this ledgr version.", as.character(parent$sweep_schema_version[[1]])), class = c("ledgr_sweep_schema_incompatible", "ledgr_invalid_store"))     }     invisible(TRUE) }
